headline: S&P 500 Top Movers Today: HONA Tops Gainers, TWLO Tops Decliners
summary: S&P 500 top movers today: HONA, EOG, EXE, NI, EQT, MSI, BKR, KMI, IDXX and SLB gained, while TWLO, MRNA, SMCI, CRWD, FTNT, DDOG, PLTR, COHR, FLEX and STX declined.

headline: JP Morgan Maintains Overweight on IDEXX Laboratories, Lowers Price Target to $750
summary: JP Morgan  analyst Chris Schott   maintains IDEXX Laboratories (NASDAQ:IDXX) with a Overweight and lowers the price target from $775 to $750.
